This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2.
This interlocutory application has been filed at the instance of the Appellant for his release on interim bail.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the Appellant, learned counsel for the Respondent No.2-Victim as well as learned counsel for the State-Respondent No.1.
4.

The above noted appeal has been filed at the instance of the Appellant-Convict challenging the judgment dated 16.04.2025 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Court for POCSO, Sonepur in Spl. G.R. Case No.16 of 2021 thereby convicting the Appellant for commission of an offence under Section 376(2)(n) of the I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act and he has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for 21 years 3 months 17 days along with a fine of Rs.12,550/- and, in default thereof, to undergo further Rigorous Imprisonment for a period of one year.

sentences.text: , an F.I.R. was lodged against the present Appellant alleging commission of an offence punishable under the provision of POCSO Act and thereafter the Petitioner faced the trial and was convicted by the trial court.
6. Learned counsel for the Appellant, at this juncture, contended that the families have agreed to the marriage of the Appellant and the Respondent No.2-Victim.
7. Learned counsel appearing for the Respondent No.2-Victim stated before this Court that the Victim has no objection in the event the Appellant is released on interim bail for some time.
8. Learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, objected for release of the Appellant on interim bail by referring to the gravity and seriousness of the allegation.

9. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties, on a careful examination of the background facts of the present case, further taking into consideration the grounds taken in the Interlocutory Application, this Court directs that the Appellant be released on interim bail for a period of four weeks from the date of his release in Spl. G.R. Case No.16 of 2021 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Spl. Court for POCSO, Sonepur or the court in seisin over the matter on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper.
10. It is further made clear that on expiry of interim bail period, the Appellant shall surrender before the court below positively.
11. The I.A. is disposed of accordingly.
12. List this appeal in the week commencing 12th December, 2025.
Surrender certificate be filed by the next date positively.
